title: Confidential portion of application or records.
bodyText: Information contained in any application or record shall be made available to the public unless that information may be withheld from public disclosure by the commissioner under chapter 92F.
bodyHtml: [§449-1.8]  Confidential portion of application or records.  Information contained in any application or record shall be made available to the public unless that information may be withheld from public disclosure by the commissioner under chapter 92F. [L 2001, c 184, pt of §1]
